response.script: You already pour Del Maguey; Ilegal sits right beside it in your guests' taste. Whisler's ranks first of 25 for this brand's profile in Austin (affinity 0.87; ev-0001) and shares the room's top tags: bars and cocktail culture (ev-0004). Take the Espadín Joven on a six-bottle trial and park it next to the Montelobos on the back bar; the smoky-sweet profile matches your 25–34 core (demographic index 0.82; ev-0003). If it sits, we collect it.
